handoff_summary: PASS. All four pillar checks and all decisions-log checks pass. All six earlier issues are resolved. (1) DANIEL_OPT_07 and DANIEL_OPT_08 now carry an explicit gate: basement only, after DANIEL_IN_BASEMENT. (2) The poster lines are retagged to step 0 as ARTHUR_S0_12 and ARTHUR_S0_13, are location-neutral, and have no landing staging. (3) ARTHUR_S3_O2 and ARTHUR_S3_O3 are non-spatial. (4) The unclear 'carry it' wording is removed. (5) TED_S3_01 and TED_S3_02 are staged in the hall. (6) The poster lines are gated to after SAILORS_INSIDE, so Arthur is always present. For implementation: enforce the gates on DANIEL_OPT_07/08 and ARTHUR_S0_12/13 in code, since they exist only as note text. Optionally, the creator may confirm who owns the powered launch, because TED_S3_01 says 'Arthur's boat' while the sailors arrived by rowboat. This is non-blocking and implies nothing about why the sailors were on the water. The line set is ready for the next stage.
